title: Luxury Nashville Condo • Sleeps 10 • 3BR/3BA
description:
Welcome to Last Rodeo — your stylish Nashville escape just minutes from Broadway, Nissan Stadium, the Grand Ole Opry, and Five Points. Located in a quiet, safe neighborhood, it’s perfect for everything from a couple’s getaway to a large group trip. Our condo sleeps up to 10, with three bedrooms each featuring a private full bath — no sharing required. Whether you’re here for music, sports, nightlife, or a bachelorette weekend, Last Rodeo blends modern comfort with Nashville character.

The space
Living Spaces

Kitchen: Fully Equipped Kitchen with Complimentary Coffee 

Living Room: Large Sofa with a 55 inch TV

Room 1: King Size bed with a TV and  its own full bathroom
Room 2: Queen Size bed with a TV and its own full bathroom
Room 3: 2 Full Bunk Beds with their own full bathroom

Appliances
Washer and Dryer
Microwave
DIshwasher
Stove and Over

Outdoor spaces – Key Less Entry into Building, Parking Lot and front patio!

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire condo and its Wifi. There is a keyless entry into the building and condo for check in. On the 4th floor there is a treadmill and peloton.
